register_custom_handler: register a custom class with DumpContext.register to serialize and deserialize objects via __dump_info__ and __load_from_info__
dump_and_load_values: dump numpy arrays and dicts to disk using DumpContext.dump and restore them with DumpContext.load
dump_entry_jsonl: write keyed entries to a shared JSONL file using DumpContext.dump_entry for indexed serialization
test_handler_roundtrip: test that a DumpContext handler roundtrips values correctly by dumping and loading with cache_type specified
cache_with_invalidation: use DumpContext.cached to memoize expensive factory calls and DumpContext.invalidate to force recomputation
